verdict.rationale: Bland's in-product Evals use LLM judges to grade each dimension of your calls, which is a form of AI-generated assessment of your own call data. There is no evidence of AI-generated insights, summaries, or improvement suggestions surfaced in the product. Analytics querying is documented only through the external MCP server driven by a coding agent, not inside the product. Missing for 10: in-product AI insights or summaries across call data, AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
